dataset: Wisconsin Diagnostic Breast Cancer (569 observations, 30 features)
split: Stratified 80:20 train/test; then stratified 70:30 fit/adaptation split within training

strategies.No update: Fit model on fit subset; unchanged.
strategies.Probability recalibration: Fit logistic calibration mapping on labelled shifted adaptation subset; base model unchanged.
strategies.Full model retraining: Refit same model family on fit subset transformed to shift plus shifted labelled adaptation subset.

bootstrap: 2000 paired bootstrap resamples of the 20 seed-level paired differences; percentile 95% intervals.
calibration: Logistic calibration regression of outcome on logit(predicted P(benign)); ideal intercept 0, slope 1.
caveats: Repeated random splits overlap in observations and are not independent external replications.
Bootstrap intervals quantify variability across these random seeds/splits, not population-level clinical uncertainty.
Synthetic shifts are not real temporal/site/population shifts.
The balanced prevalence condition uses balanced resampling, not a prospective prior-shift design.
